verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration service, so dependent visas are a fair question. The evidence pack covers O-1, H-1B, TN, L-1, EB-1A and EB-2 NIW filings, but nothing mentions O-3 or H-4 dependent petitions or dependent work authorization as part of the service. The H-1B 'transfers and extensions' item concerns the principal worker, not family members.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service
